title: Shelf Value
story: Which shelf holds the most money? Stock value is price times stock, added up per category.
goal: Return each category and its total stock value (price × stock) as value, biggest first.

tests.label: Hidden check on other data
Hidden check on other data

hints: Multiply inside the aggregate: SUM(price * stock).
ORDER BY can use the alias you created: ORDER BY value DESC.
SELECT category, SUM(price * stock) AS value FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY value DESC;
socratic: What do you multiply for one product?
What do you add up per category?
Compare the rows you got with the rows expected. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what does your query do?
solution: SELECT category, SUM(price * stock) AS value FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY value DESC;
alt: SELECT category, SUM(stock * price) AS value FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY SUM(stock * price) DESC;
